_about: Declared seats for the status page. station = the machine the seat runs on. The watcher reads seats on its OWN station from their local checkout (repo folder + 'checkout' suffix, HANDOFF.md), and seats on other stations from origin (task file + last commit matching 'commits'). Add a seat here, no code change. Card title links to the seat's Claude session: 'url' (fixed link, e.g. a remote station's Remote Control session) or 'session' (a local session NAME: the watcher looks up its current Remote Control id in ~/.claude/sessions, so a restarted session only needs its new name here).
